name: Transect-Tape v1.0.0
description: Transect-Tape v1.0.0 is a multi-source underwater dataset for survey-tape instance segmentation. It provides 12,742 final non-empty YOLO polygon labels containing 16,449 instances, a fixed source-disjoint benchmark split, five leave-one-source-out definitions, provenance and integrity fingerprints, benchmark code, and the historical zero-shot audit. The release consists of one core ZIP and four source-aligned RGB ZIPs that extract into one transect_tape_dataset/ tree. The record directly includes 7,128 complete RGB–label pairs from the pool, YouTube 1/JCU, CoralVOS, and CoralScapes sources. Only the 5,614 YouTube 2/3 RGB images are withheld because redistribution permission was not received; their polygon labels, exact source/frame mappings, transformations, hashes, and tools/reconstruct_missing_images.py workflow are included for reconstruction from lawfully obtained local source videos. The canonical down-looking split assigns 9,395 images to training (Pool videos 1–3 and YouTube 2/3), 1,015 CoralVOS images to validation, and 1,262 YouTube 1 images to test. CoralScapes is a separate 1,070-image front-view out-of-distribution set. Whole sources are separated to prevent source/session leakage.
